context.passage:
Northern Regional Railways
NOTICE: March 2
Northern Regional Railways (NRR) invites all riders to take advantage of a special
discount for early booking on local routes between Fairview and East City. Make your
reservation online at least ten days in advance, and you can save 20 percent on any
round-trip ticket. Simply enter promotion code 10302.
Restrictions: Tickets purchased under this discount program must be used by
September 1. This offer does not apply to express routes. Riders cannot combine this
offer with points earned in the NRR Frequent Rider Rewards program.
